newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease on back of bank SKB.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease on back of bank SKB.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased on Tuesday, pulled down by a fall in SKB bank, and traders forecast shares would remain range-bound over the short term.
* The SBI index fell 8.92 points to 1,334.94.
* Overall nine shares fell and seven rose, while 11 were untraded.
* SKB had the highest turnover, falling 0.89 percent to 50,000 tolars on volume of 491 shares for total turnover of 24.6 million tolars.
